registeredExperiments.question: Can every full-question candidate and every physical provider call be attributed to an immutable run, policy and cost stage before the API campaign starts?
success: Atomic campaign cap cannot exceed 1000 under concurrency
Requested plan, effective plan and served model are distinct

registeredExperiments.population: Existing premium grammar ladder outputs plus known disputed/no-answer grammar cases
registeredExperiments.hypothesis: A solver contract requiring correctedForm, isKeySurfaceUngrammatical, governingRule and per-option validity catches keyed-but-defensible errors that label convergence misses.
registeredExperiments.comparison: Current label-only decision versus enriched structured adjudication, blinded to stored explanation
registeredExperiments.primaryOutcome: fatal recall at fixed false-block rate
registeredExperiments.promotionRule: Promote to paired generation only if every known no-answer case is caught and clean-item false blocks remain below the preregistered threshold.

registeredExperiments.population: Existing rejection-pool and shipped relaxed/scarce grammar artifacts
registeredExperiments.hypothesis: Removing correctness failures from salvage while retaining only craft warnings eliminates fatal shipment without an unacceptable zero-output increase.
registeredExperiments.note: Codes may be split more finely after replay; the experiment does not assume every parent code has identical severity.

registeredExperiments.population: Historical BLANK_INFERENCE artifacts including the 7/15 fixed-tail failure
registeredExperiments.hypothesis: Substituting all five options into the exact prefix/suffix boundary and checking shared syntactic compatibility blocks grammar-only elimination with low false-positive rate.
registeredExperiments.nonGoal: Do not infer semantic quality from a surface seam check.

registeredExperiments.population: Frozen clean-candidate and noisy robustness passage queues
registeredExperiments.hypothesis: A zero-call source preflight catches punctuation/OCR/delimiter corruption and routes semantic-negation uncertainty to review before generation.
registeredExperiments.nonGoal: Deterministic checks do not certify logical truth or discourse coherence.

factors: site-candidate-first with valency-risk exclusion and explicit correction certificate
registeredExperiments.earlyStop: Stop the cell on any new no-answer/multiple-answer pattern pending root-cause review.
Stop if fatal rate increases, if two pilot items repeat the same filler pattern, or if cost doubles without a clear craft gain.

rejectedHypothesesImportedFromPriorWork: Apply the full premium ladder to STANDARD grammar without a new cost-quality result
Treat validator presence without enforcement as a quality improvement
Infer all-type quality from four representative types times five items
